      <line x1="343" y1="14" x2="351" y2="14"/>

    <g transform="translate(195 318)">
      <rect x="-68" y="-18" width="68" height="36" rx="18" fill="#4285F4">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;90;180;270;360" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <rect x="0" y="-18" width="68" height="36" rx="18" fill="#EA4437">

        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;90;180;270;360" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <animate attributeName="height" values="68;42;68;42;68" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <rect x="-18" y="0" width="36" height="68" rx="18" fill="#379D53">

        <animate attributeName="x" values="4;18;4;-10;4" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>

    <!-- orbiting blocks -->
    <g>
      <rect x="104" y="300" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="#4285F4">
        <animate attributeName="x" values="104;276;104" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <animate attributeName="y" values="300;336;300" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
      <rect x="274" y="330" width="7" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#EA4437">
        <animate attributeName="x" values="274;106;274" dur="3.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      </rect>
      <rect x="188" y="214" width="7" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#FBBE0D">
        <animate attributeName="y" values="214;414;214" dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <rect x="188" y="415" width="7" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#379D53">
        <animate attributeName="y" values="415;214;415" dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

        <animate attributeName="width" values="24;42;24" dur="1.2s" begin="0.45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </rect>
    </g>

      <circle cx="137" cy="815" r="7" fill="none"/>

</svg>
